## ICLR Rebuttal (weight 1.12)

- **Task:** Add rewrite‑vs‑naive‑append ablation  
  - Use MemGPT’s paging as the naive baseline.  
  - Run on the workshop’s benchmark dataset.  
- **Deadline:** Day‑19  
- **Draft reply:**  
  > *“We will include an ablation comparing our rewrite mechanism against a simple external‑memory paging baseline (implemented via MemGPT). Preliminary results are 0.02‑0.04 bigger accuracy on Task X; full results will be ready by the Day‑19 deadline.”*

---

## Workshop Paper Co‑author (weight 0.52)

- **Task:** Review rough outline; provide concise feedback.  
- **Draft reply:**  
  > *“The outline is solid. Clarify the benchmark evaluation protocol and the role of the naive‑append baseline. Also include a discussion section on how our framework generalizes to other agents.”*  
- **Suggested deadline:** Day‑15 (to meet workshop submission)

---

## Read‑later: MemGPT Paper

- Keep for internal reference; will inform baseline implementation.

---

## Overnight idea  

- Create a benchmark that *explicitly* includes a naive‑append baseline derived from MemGPT’s external‑memory paging. This satisfies the reviewer’s isolation requirement and provides a reusable suite for all sleep‑time memory rewrite methods.
